working_tree: Intentional uncommitted sprint changes are part of the tested source; this evidence does not describe a frozen candidate SHA.
scope: Decode ordinary PostgreSQL custom-enum scalar values as exact text.
Decode ordinary PostgreSQL custom-enum arrays as exact PostgreSQL array text, retaining SQL NULL elements distinctly from the label text.
Preserve ordinary custom-enum labels and SQL NULL through schema-aware keyed grid updates and draft inserts, with native persisted type/value and sibling-row assertions.
Resolve schema-aware keyed edits against the exact enum type when two schemas contain identically named enum types and tables.
Keep custom-enum catalog metadata internal to ColumnInfo so it does not change the serialized protocol shape.

The literal enum label NULL is preserved on schema-aware keyed writes and draft inserts, on direct scalar/array results, and on text values explicitly cast through bound parameters; it remains distinct from SQL NULL. Vendored SQLx 0.9.0 now preserves quoted NULL labels during text-array metadata decoding.
Schema-aware PostgreSQL enum filters cast text parameters to the catalog-qualified enum type for equality, ordering, BETWEEN and IN operators; literal NULL labels remain distinct from SQL NULL.

Import PostgreSQL custom-enum CSV values through catalog-qualified casts. Refuse default blank enum cells when empty labels and SQL NULL are indistinguishable; preserve both when the importer has an explicit null marker.
The shared render_json result serializer preserves PostgreSQL enum empty text, literal NULL, Unicode and SQL NULL as distinct JSON values.

When PostgreSQL expression context identifies a custom enum parameter, infer its server OID for Value::Text and Value::Null across query, direct execute and transaction helpers; preserve existing text behavior when context is ambiguous or plain text.

Exercise PostgreSQL custom-enum execute_query and export_data JSON/CSV paths through MCP: preserve exact JSON values and server type; return a per-result null marker absent from exported text, then import the exact CSV response with that marker and verify native values/types.

Cover the core PostgreSQL custom-enum CSV file-writer and schema-aware importer as one round trip: show a collision-free marker in the app export dialog, preserve the destination on ambiguous default blanks, and verify native enum values/types after importing exact raw-text file output, including a formula-shaped label.
Replay PostgreSQL custom-enum SQL result-file output into a same-type destination and verify values, enum type, NULL distinctions, and quoted adversarial text.
Exercise PostgreSQL custom-enum values through the core XML result-file writer, preserving literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, SQL NULL, and safely escaped markup/entity text.
Exercise PostgreSQL custom-enum values through the core HTML result-file writer, preserving literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, SQL NULL, and escaped hostile markup.
Preserve PostgreSQL custom-enum distinctions through the core Markdown result-file writer: text cells are JSON-quoted, SQL NULL remains unquoted, and table/inline-markup characters are escaped.
Cover PostgreSQL custom-enum XLSX output: non-empty enum text remains a shared-string cell distinct from SQL NULL, while empty enum labels are explicitly refused with atomic destination preservation.
Distinguish lossless raw-text PostgreSQL enum CSV from spreadsheet-safe output, including native import behavior when formula prefixing collides with a valid enum label.

PostgreSQL 16 contracts preserve domain-over-enum values and native type through scalar/array projections, structured filters, keyed updates, draft inserts, shared/file JSON output, replayed SQL result files and MCP query/export/import, XML/HTML/Markdown files and XLSX output/refusal. Text and SQL NULL parameters use explicit domain casts; implicit equality between two domain values is not supported by PostgreSQL. The app parser retains enum label text for domain columns.

regressions.assertions: Direct scalar labels ready/paused, SQL NULL, native pg_typeof text, and array text {"ready","paused",NULL}.
regressions.before_fix: Failed: non-NULL labels decoded as Undecodable(VALUE_CONTRACT_PLAIN_ENUM). See before-fix.txt.
regressions.after_fix: Passed in the focused enum selection and complete PostgreSQL integration suite.

regressions.assertions: Direct scalar enum results preserve literal NULL, Unicode, apostrophe labels and SQL NULL with exact pg_typeof text. Explicitly cast bound text values and bound SQL NULL return native enum values. UPDATE RETURNING stores the literal label and its trigger fires exactly once.
regressions.boundary: SQLx text-array decoding now tracks whether NULL was quoted; the vendor unit regression proves the quoted string stays text while unquoted NULL remains SQL NULL.

regressions.assertions: Direct custom enum-array projection preserves literal NULL, Unicode, apostrophe labels and a SQL NULL element as exact canonical PostgreSQL array text; independent server JSON/type oracles remain asserted.
Vendored SQLx unit test decodes quoted NULL as Some("NULL"), unquoted NULL as None, lowercase null, empty text and ordinary text distinctly.
Binary enum-array wire values for literal NULL, empty text, comma, quote, Unicode and SQL NULL; invalid UTF-8 is refused.
Fetch schema-qualified catalog enum metadata; keyed-update and draft-insert ordinary and literal NULL labels plus SQL NULL; verify native type and exact sibling values.

Two schemas define status_kind and items. A fresh pool connection uses search_path=enum_shadow_a while the app fetches and edits enum_shadow_b.items. Verify current_schema, target enum metadata, pg_typeof and sibling rows; the target enum changes and the same-named shadow enum/table stays unchanged.
regressions.coverage_kind: PostgreSQL 16 Docker-backed native enum schema-collision regression under an adverse search_path setting.
regressions.result: Focused case passed; all 10 ignored enum_contract integration tests passed; PostgreSQL driver Clippy passed.

regressions.assertions: Core builder SQL for keyed update and draft insert quotes a schema with a space and a type name containing a double quote; text and SQL NULL are cast through text to the catalog type.
Serialize ColumnInfo containing PostgreSQL enum metadata, assert enum_type is absent, then deserialize and assert it defaults to None.
The app's PostgreSQL cell parser preserves schema-qualified custom enum labels and domain-over-enum labels as Value::Text for keyed-write consumers.

Native PostgreSQL filter results verify exact ids, labels and pg_typeof for equality, inequality, enum ordering, BETWEEN and IN using literal NULL and Unicode labels; IS NULL selects only the SQL NULL row. Unit SQL assertions pin schema-qualified casts for equality, inequality, ordering, BETWEEN and IN.
regressions.before_fix: Core SQL builder emitted status = $1 and failed its expected SQL assertion. Native PostgreSQL failed with SQLSTATE 42883: operator does not exist: value_contract_enum_filter.status = text.
regressions.after_fix: Focused core and Docker-backed PostgreSQL regressions pass. Full core unit and PostgreSQL integration suites pass.

regressions.assertions: Native PostgreSQL CSV export/import covers literal NULL, empty enum label, Unicode, apostrophe, comma, and SQL NULL. Default export blanks are refused before dispatch and the target remains empty. With explicit \N null marker, the native target values and pg_typeof match the source labels exactly.
regressions.before_fix: The native integration fixture failed because its INSERT plan emitted an untyped $2 parameter for the custom enum column. The first default-blank probe also showed empty fields were interpreted as empty text, which cannot distinguish an empty enum label from SQL NULL.
regressions.after_fix: Schema-qualified text-to-enum cast is present. The ambiguous default file is refused without writes; the explicit-marker import succeeds. Focused tests and full affected suites pass.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 returns the enum literal NULL, empty label, Unicode and SQL NULL with pg_typeof. render_json and core write_result_file JSON preserve each value. CSV file output pins quoted empty text versus blank SQL NULL. Cancelling JSON file export after one row leaves the prior destination bytes intact and removes the staged file.
regressions.initial_gap: The native fixture checked render_json but had no PostgreSQL enum contract for the atomic core file writer.
regressions.after_fix: Focused native export and cancellation assertions passed; the complete PostgreSQL integration suite passed 77 tests.
regressions.remaining: Other result-file formats are not covered by this enum case; CSV is an output encoding, not a lossless import claim.

regressions.assertions: Native PostgreSQL enum comparison finds the literal NULL label; SQL NULL matches only the SQL NULL row; direct UPDATE and transaction UPDATE persist text/Unicode under the enum type; an invalid label reports SQLSTATE 22P02; an untyped plain-text parameter remains PostgreSQL text.
regressions.before_fix: Reproduced SQLSTATE 42883: operator does not exist: value_contract_enum_bind.state = text. The first full-suite run after inference exposed SQLSTATE 22P03 because SQLx reused the metadata probe statement cache entry for a different bind layout.
regressions.after_fix: Metadata preparation uses a distinct SQL cache key; the full serial PostgreSQL integration suite passed 77 tests, including this regression and array/numeric neighbors.
regressions.fallback: Ambiguous parameter descriptions retry with existing Value type information; inferred non-enum parameters continue through the existing typed bind implementations.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 custom-enum rows flow through the production driver, McpBridge, execute_query and export_data. JSON distinguishes literal NULL, empty text, Unicode and SQL NULL and retains server type. CSV returns a marker absent from exported text (advancing from \N through \NN to \NNN when those enum labels occur); the exact response content is imported with that marker and native enum values/types are verified.
regressions.native_fixture: PostgreSQL 16 Docker; enum mcp_enum.state has labels NULL, empty, Unicode, \N and \NN plus SQL NULL.
regressions.after_fix: Focused Docker selector passed; exact MCP CSV content round-tripped through the core schema-aware importer into a PostgreSQL enum table. MCP package targets passed with Docker-only tests ignored in the ordinary tier.
regressions.remaining: Additional enum format/session configurations remain separate consumer cases; core CSV file-writer raw-text round trip is recorded in the following regression.

regressions.assertions: Raw-text export/import preserves distinct formula-like enum labels and native type. Spreadsheet-safe export prefixes =1+1; the existing literal label '=1+1 already has that output spelling, so both imported rows become the latter native enum value. The export UI identifies raw text as the lossless re-import option.
regressions.native_fixture: PostgreSQL 16 Docker; source/target tables use csv_file_enum.state with labels NULL, empty, 東京, \N and \NN plus SQL NULL.
regressions.after_fix: Focused PostgreSQL 16 Docker selector passed with both raw exact round-trip and spreadsheet-safe collision assertions.
regressions.remaining: This proves only the core PostgreSQL CSV file-writer/import configuration; other enum format/session combinations remain open.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 SQL file export is replayed into a destination with the same enum type. Verify exact rows/type for literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, SQL NULL, and an apostrophe/semicolon label shaped as DROP TABLE; destination and all rows survive.
regressions.initial_gap: No native custom-enum SQL result-file export/restore contract existed.
regressions.coverage_kind: New consumer contract; the focused test passed before any production implementation change.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 native rows assert exact labels and pg_typeof, then core XML file output distinguishes literal NULL, empty text, and SQL NULL and escapes closing-tag markup, quotes, apostrophe, ampersand, and literal entity text.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native consumer contract; production XML writer was unchanged and the focused test passed against the current implementation.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 native rows assert exact labels and pg_typeof, then core HTML output distinguishes literal NULL, empty text, and SQL NULL; an image/event-handler label is escaped and no raw image element appears.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native consumer contract; the focused test passed against the existing writer without a production implementation change.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 native rows assert exact enum labels and pg_typeof for literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, a pipe/newline label, entity-looking text, and SQL NULL; generated Markdown pins the exact explicit text encoding and keeps SQL NULL unquoted.
regressions.before_fix: Failed: both literal enum label NULL and SQL NULL were emitted as NULL; pipe/newline and entity-looking text were not represented with the explicit cell encoding.
regressions.after_fix: Passed after Markdown text cells switched to JSON string quoting and safe table/inline-markup escaping.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 rows assert exact enum labels and pg_typeof for literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, entity-looking text, formula-shaped text, and SQL NULL. Non-empty rows produce a workbook; including the empty label returns WorkbookEmptyText at row 2, column 2 and preserves existing destination bytes with no staging file.
regressions.coverage_kind: Native consumer contract. Paired core workbook inspection verifies text labels including NULL and formula-shaped text are shared-string cells, XML-sensitive text is escaped, and SQL NULL has no string cell.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 projects a literal enum label NULL, a Unicode label and SQL NULL through a domain over the enum. Exact values are compared with Value::Text/Value::Null, and pg_typeof independently confirms the domain result type. Shared JSON rendering and the JSON result-file writer preserve literal NULL and Unicode as text and SQL NULL as null; the file JSON matches the expected native values.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native domain projection, shared JSON and JSON file-writer consumer contract; no production change was needed.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 projects a domain-over-enum array containing literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, a comma-containing label and SQL NULL. Exact PostgreSQL array text is checked alongside independent array_to_json values and pg_typeof array type.
regressions.before_fix: Failed: the server value/type oracles were correct, but the driver returned Undecodable(VALUE_CONTRACT_DOMAIN_ARRAY_LABEL[]).
regressions.after_fix: Passed after the binary array decoder followed domain metadata to its enum base and decoded labels as text.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native result contract and production decoder fix.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 binds a literal NULL label and SQL NULL through explicit casts to a domain over a custom enum. A parameterized update stores a text label in the domain column; returned values and pg_typeof verify exact value/type preservation.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native parameter/update consumer contract; no production change was needed.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 catalog metadata resolves a domain-over-enum column to its base enum for structured filter casts. Equality and IN preserve exact labels; IS NULL matches only SQL NULL. Native pg_typeof confirms the domain column type. The same metadata drives keyed update and draft insert; native rows preserve their domain type.
regressions.before_fix: Failed: a structured comparison emitted an untyped parameter and PostgreSQL returned SQLSTATE 42883, operator does not exist: value_contract_domain_filter.status_domain = unknown.
regressions.after_fix: Passed after catalog lookup exposed the base enum and the filter builder cast both column and parameter through that enum type.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native filter/write consumer contract and catalog/filter-builder fix.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 renders a domain-over-enum result to raw CSV with an explicit \N marker and imports literal NULL, empty text, Unicode and SQL NULL. Default blank ambiguity is refused before writes. Source and destination values match, and pg_typeof confirms the destination domain type.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native domain CSV export/import consumer contract; no production change was needed.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 infers uncast text and SQL NULL parameters from assignment to a domain-over-enum column. Native reads assert exact values, pg_typeof domain type and an unchanged sibling row.
regressions.before_fix: Failed with SQLSTATE 42804: PostgreSQL inferred the domain target, but the driver bound the parameter as text.
regressions.after_fix: Passed after parameter description followed domain metadata to its enum base for custom enum binding.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native implicit assignment-parameter regression and driver metadata fix.

regressions.assertions: Raw domain = $1 returns PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 42883. Casting the domain column to its base enum allows text and NULL parameters to be inferred as that enum; pg_typeof($1), pg_typeof(status), comparison outcomes and NULL behavior are asserted.
regressions.probe_finding: The first test draft expected the raw domain comparison to work; PostgreSQL rejected the operator during query parsing. The final contract records that as the explicit server refusal and verifies the supported base-enum comparison path.
regressions.result: Focused test passed; the domain_contract group passed all 10 Docker-backed tests.
regressions.coverage_kind: Native domain-over-enum comparison parameter context, including explicit refusal and inferred supported path.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 SQL result-file output replays literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, a statement-shaped label and SQL NULL into a same-domain table. Exact expected values and pg_typeof verify native preservation; a neighboring table remains unchanged.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native domain SQL file-writer/replay consumer contract; no production change was needed.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 domain-over-enum rows pass through MCP execute_query and JSON/CSV export_data. The exact CSV response and its collision-free NULL marker are imported into a second domain column; native values and pg_typeof verify literal NULL, empty text, Unicode and SQL NULL.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native MCP query/export/import vertical contract for domain-over-enum values.

regressions.assertions: PostgreSQL 16 domain-over-enum rows with literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, hostile markup, pipe/newline, formula text and SQL NULL are checked against pg_typeof. XML/HTML/Markdown preserve distinctions and escape text. XLSX writes non-empty labels and explicitly refuses empty text while preserving existing destination bytes and leaving no staging file.
regressions.coverage_kind: New native domain XML/HTML/Markdown/XLSX file-writer contract with explicit empty-cell refusal.
